heroes.name: Riptide
heroes.description: Prefers enemies at a comfortable distance — ideally several zip codes away. Lays traps, fires arrows, and somehow still blames the dice.

heroes.name: Kai
heroes.description: Studied arcane arts for twelve years just to set things on fire slightly faster than everyone else. Has singed every cape he's ever owned.

heroes.name: Benji
heroes.description: Arrives unannounced, deals catastrophic damage, and leaves before the dust settles. Also never washes the dishes.

heroes.name: Briar
heroes.description: Fuses arcane magic with sharp steel — which sounds impressive until you realize the runes just say 'please win' in elvish.

heroes.name: Phantom
heroes.description: Technically present in every fight. Nobody can confirm this. Not even the opponents. Especially not the opponents.

heroes.name: Valkyrie
heroes.description: A battle-scarred champion with a sword bigger than most people's life ambitions. Hits first, considers philosophy later.

heroes.name: Aether
heroes.description: Weaves elemental chaos into devastating spell combos. Also owns seventeen robes and considers them all 'battle-appropriate'.

heroes.name: Thorn
heroes.description: Has a deep spiritual bond with nature. Nature seems only mildly enthusiastic about this. Still summons things when needed.

heroes.name: Blaze
heroes.description: Setting things on fire is not just a skill, it's a personality. Has been banned from three taverns. All burned down. Coincidence.

heroes.name: Frostbite
heroes.description: Controls ice with pinpoint precision and absolutely zero chill. Freezes enemies solid and then sighs dramatically.

heroes.name: Shadow
heroes.description: Strikes from darkness with surgical precision. Wrote a memoir titled 'You Never Saw Me'. It was a bestseller. Nobody knows who wrote it.

heroes.name: Titan
heroes.description: An immovable fortress of muscle and misplaced confidence. Takes hits so teammates don't have to. Secretly enjoys it.

heroes.name: Luna
heroes.description: The only hero who makes everyone else look useful by keeping them alive. Gets zero glory and maximum passive-aggression at the end of every match.

heroes.name: Tempest
heroes.description: Commands lightning, wind, and the occasional hailstorm. Has strong opinions about weather and will share them mid-combat.

heroes.name: Viper
heroes.description: Fast, venomous, and absolutely unbearable to play against. Wins by annoying opponents into making mistakes. It works every time.

heroes.name: Axel
heroes.description: Charges into battle with the grace of a falling wardrobe. Damage output is impressive. Surviving long enough to deal it is another story.

heroes.name: Nyx
heroes.description: Creates flawless illusions that confuse, disorient, and baffle enemies. Also uses them to skip queues. Multi-talented.

heroes.name: Gideon
heroes.description: Shines with holy light and righteous fury. Has memorized the rulebook. All of them. Points out infractions mid-fight. Still somehow popular.

heroes.name: Zara
heroes.description: Channels ancestral spirits who are frankly unimpressed with the current generation. The spirits cooperate anyway out of a sense of obligation.

heroes.name: Flux
heroes.description: Builds gadgets, traps, and questionable inventions on the fly. Occasionally they work exactly as intended. The rest of the time, so does plan B.
